owner: AppStore/film (Claude session). The website session reads this file and doesn’t edit it.
what: A silent, seamless 8.6-second loop of Apple’s iPhone Duo model held part-folded like a book. It opens on the outer display’s manga cover and holds there, turns round to the reading spread, holds briefly, and turns back to the cover. No text labels; flat app paper (#F5F0E6) behind.

files.poster_is: the loop’s first frame: the cover side, yaw 245°
files.still_cover_is: yaw 232°, outer display towards the camera (still from the earlier cut; the loop now turns to 245°)
files.still_reading_is: yaw 40°, both inner pages in view
files.display: 1600 × 1200 (4:3); use object-fit: contain. The device never touches the frame edge.

loop.why_cover_first: The section is about cover mode, so the loop opens and lingers on the cover; the reading spread is the brief middle.

pose.model: Apple’s iPhone Duo model V68.usdz from Xcode 27.1’s DeviceHub plugin, rendered with RealityKit (tools/duo-render), Dark finish
pose.scale: 1060 px for the device’s 164.6 mm open width (6.44 px/mm), uniform: true model proportions, never scaled per axis
pose.shadow: soft warm shadow (rgb 60,45,25 at 28%, 30 px blur, 24 px drop) that moves with the device

inner_display.source: assets/source/recordings/sample-curl.mov at 14.0 s: a screen recording of Honbako’s reader in the Honbako Capture duo simulator (E10C41ED-6783-467C-BB45-754B539F5E7F), the same recording as honbako-duo-page-turn
inner_display.processing: tools/clean-fold.py removes the simulator’s fold shading only
inner_display.story: 星を待つ駅 / After The Last Train (book-001), Honbako’s original sample story, character art by Wataobi

cover_source.file: the sample’s own cover, Documents/HonbakoLicensedSample/cover-01.jpg in the capture simulator’s app container (book-001’s cover in its manifest) (copied to assets/source/cover-showcase/sample-cover-01.jpg)

outer_display.treatment: HonbakoCoverDisplayView’s drawing, reproduced: #1A1A1A ground (Color(white: 0.10)), cover scaled to fit (1356 × 2034 at x 21), colorMultiply 0.78, SumiPaperSurface.inkTile grain (the paper.js port, 3× tile) over it
outer_display.why: Relaunching the capture simulator with -Honbako.Reader.ShowCoverDisplay YES (and the per-book key) logged the cover display’s camera-session start, but the outer-display screenshot stayed black: the grid-check sample fixture forces the cover setting off. The app and fixture weren’t changed to get round it.
outer_display.upgrade: A genuine outer-display capture can replace this file (same 1398 × 2034 size); rerun the command below.

claims: Duo cover display is a Honbako Pro feature. The loop carries no text; say so in the site copy where it is shown.
not_black_jack: Only the original sample story appears. No film frames are reused.
rebuild: node tools/cover-demo.mjs (needs npm run duo first); --probe 40,245 writes single stills to review/cover-probe/
film_untouched: renders/ and the 45-second film outputs were not changed by this asset.
simulator: Restored afterwards: hinge back to 180°, app relaunched with its original launch arguments (cover off).
